newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-KELLER CALLED UP FOR DENMARK MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KELLER CALLED UP FOR DENMARK MATCH.

text.p: Karlsruhe striker Marc Keller was named in French coach Aime Jacquet's squad on Monday for Saturday`s friendly against Denmark in Copenhagen.
Keller, who has been playing superbly in the Bundesliga, has appeared for his country only once before, as a substitute in the 2-0 win over Israel in a European championship qualifier last year.
All the big names currently playing in Italy, including AC Milan's Marcel Desailly and Juventus pair Didier Deschamps and Zinedine Zidane, were called up.

But there was again no place for England-based Eric Cantona and David Ginola. Cantona is at present struggling for form with champions Manchester United although Ginola has performed brilliantly for leaders Newcastle in recent games.
Of 10 players in the squad at non-French clubs, only Chelsea central defender Franck Leboeuf plays in the English league.
Jacquet's side beat Mexico 2-0 in August and Turkey 4-0 last month.
Defenders: Vincent Candela (Guingamp), Marcel Desailly (AC Milan), Alain Goma (Auxerre), Franck Leboeuf (Chelsea), Lilian Thuram (Parma).

Midfielders: Didier Deschamps (Juventus), Christian Karembeu (Sampdoria), Pierre Laigle (Sampdoria), Corentin Martins (Deportivo La Coruna), Bruno N'Gotty (Paris St Germain), Zinedine Zidane (Juventus).
Strikers: Youri Djorkaeff (Internazionale), Marc Keller (Karlsruhe), Patrice Loko (Paris St Germain), Reynald Pedros (Marseille), Robert Pires (Metz).
